selection_metric: micro exact token-span F1, SKILL/KNOWLEDGE union

ner_grid.head: independent BIO SKILL and BIO KNOWLEDGE token classifiers
ner_grid.subword_policy: loss on first subtoken only; ignore padding and special tokens
ner_grid.green_auxiliary: Skill head only; mask Knowledge head and non-Skill entity targets; do not infer KNOWLEDGE negatives

external_evaluation.green: Skill-only span metric after annotation-policy review; evaluation partition never used for selection
external_evaluation.techwolf: sentence multi-label/ESCO normalization only after explicit taxonomy mapping
external_evaluation.skill_xl: sentence multi-label/relevance only after annotation completeness and cluster semantics review
external_evaluation.skillspan_test: frozen; historically exposed; no automatic evaluation in this workflow
